pipeline_notes.parser_test_coverage: Three documents cover all known structural types: narrative_visualization_workbook (explicit PART headings + guided visualizations), theological_workbook (Section N: headings + reflection questions). Any new document type encountered in production should be flagged for manual review and a new detection branch added.
